text:
elena_sales: Hey team — AcmeCorp POC scheduled next Thu. They want a Dedicated pool with reserved capacity for the demo and the ability to burst. Requesting 8 reserved GPUs, autoscale up to 12 GPUs for a 2 hour demo window. Also need a short-lived API key for the app to call the Dedicated endpoint and VPC peering details. Any pricing or process notes?

max_engineering: Sounds doable. Two quick questions — expected sustained tokens/sec vs spike? and preferred region?

elena_sales: Mostly spikes during interactive sessions, estimate 9k tokens/sec sustained with spikes up to ~18k for 10–15 mins. Region: us-west-2.

max_engineering: OK. Recommendation: reserve min_gpus=8, allow burst to 12 with burst_credits allocated. We'll set a 5min grace window for scale up and 10min cooldown. Example autoscale policy we can push: 
```json
{
  "min_gpus": 8,
  "max_gpus": 12,
  "scale_metric": "request_qps",
  "scale_target_qps_per_gpu": 1500,
  "burst_credits": 1200,
  "scale_up_grace_sec": 300,
  "cooldown_sec": 600
}
```
This should cover the 15min spike pattern. Burst credits are consumed while running >min_gpus.

june_solutions: For access: we'll create an ephemeral service API key scoped to the Dedicated pool and expiry=72h. Also create a short-lived peering ticket for the network team — will send VPC peering playbook. Need the customer's VPC CIDR + contact.

priya_sre: Security note — confirm KMS key usage for any customer-managed keys and ensure audit logs forwarded to their S3 if required. For peering, we require a CIDR allowlist and we block 0.0.0.0/0 egress by default on Dedicated control traffic. Also record that we need completed security questionnaire answers for outbound endpoints.

elena_sales: @june_solutions i'll DM the acme infra contact (mike@acme). Their CIDR: 10.44.0.0/16. They want encrypted egress + our side uses KMS-managed keys.

june_solutions: Received — starting peering request and will provision the ephemeral API key. I'll attach the peering ticket number when created.

max_engineering: I’ll queue the Dedicated pool change and autoscaler profile. ETA ~90min for infra to reflect once ticket created.

deploy-bot: Provisioning job started: job_id=provision-1961234567-acme, reserved_gpus=8, target_region=us-west-2

priya_sre: Also logging a note — set retention for audit logs = 90 days for the POC. If Acme requires longer, we'll escalate to SOC.

elena_sales: Quick pricing Q from customer: is there a surcharge for temporary burst above reserved?

max_engineering: Pricing answer: reserved capacity billed at monthly committed rate pro-rated for POC window. Burst GPUs billed at on-demand rate + a small transient surcharge (5%) to cover burst credits. I'll confirm exact USD estimate and post here.

june_solutions: API key will be scoped to pool:dedicated-acme-poc and will expire 72h after creation. We'll also add IP allowlist to the key using the Acme egress IPs.

elena_sales: Perfect. Can you post the final autoscale JSON and estimated cost delta here when ready? I'll forward to the customer. :thumbsup:

max_engineering: Will post the final config and a rough cost delta within the hour.

june_solutions: Peering ticket created: PT-44219. Sharing docs: https://redwood.example.com/docs/dedicated/autoscale and the quick peering checklist.

elena_sales: Thanks all — i'll confirm demo details with Acme and circle back if they sign off on the CIDR and go-ahead. :white_check_mark:
